node.capacityQualification: Final sample is after scheduled backup completion and normal retention; initial and active-writer samples are historical snapshots.

normalizedCore.scope: all stored confirmed transaction raw bytes and normalized detail rows

integrity.coverageLimit: Full indexed transaction population and every block of scan range948000–969387; not genesis, every unrelated transaction, or live physical-page integrity.

addressScriptWitnessCore.scope: all stored confirmed transaction normalized output/input addresses, script signatures, witnesses, raw bytes, values, prevouts and positions
addressScriptWitnessCore.normalization: Case-preserving decoded script addresses, canonical no-address normalized to SQL NULL; optional empty script signature normalized to NULL; absent witness normalized to empty array; SQL NULL witness is compared distinctly, not coerced to empty array. Addresses/scripts/array contents are compared exactly after only production-defined canonical normalization.

pendingIdAdmissionTimeCore.source: Direct Core getmempoolentry, no global mempool enumeration or application API request

sync.qualification: Full-population reconciliation pinned969387; later direct authority sync969389. Exact-tip API/worker proof belongs to its observed snapshot, not retroactively this latertip.

keepUi.verificationModel: Installed verified-release function imported without main; all surface file/mode/SHA256+archive hash checked; lock opened rb; no writes/deletes.
keepUi.dependencyQualification: Declared dependency SHA256 retained in manifests; source HEAD/tree freshly compared to manifests, but node_modules dependency bytes were not independently rehashed by this audit.

uiReview.deletionEligibility: Review candidates only: prior designated dependencies/holds still protect items; explicit exact manifest+dependency release+fresh under-lock validation required. Allocations overlap; not guaranteed reclaimed bytes.

nodeNetworkHealth.netTotalsQualification: Core process counters since restart; independent of physical NIC accounting and billing periods. target=0 means no configured upload byte cap; bytes_left_in_cycle=0 is not a cap exhaustion.
nodeNetworkHealth.followup: No peer-connectivity or mempool-capacity anomaly observed. Unlimited Core upload target should be compared with VPS transfer allowance if metered; no billed-allowance information was available.
nodeNetworkHealth.mempoolApiTipQualification: Mempool API tip witness is later than direct Core batch; adjacent heights can be normal moving-chain observations and are not a simultaneous parity proof.
